paite: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah akum sawmna, huai tuh Nebukadnezzar akum sawm-le-giatna ahi, Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
heading: Jeremiah In Lou Alei
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Huai in Babulon kumpipa sepaihhon in Jerusalem a-um ua; huan Judah kumpipa' inn ngakmi huangsung ah zawlnei Jeremiah atang hi.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Bangdia, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe ding a ala ding;
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leng Kaldai mite khut a kipan apawt kei ding, Babulon kumpipa khut a matsak in a-om zaw ding a, kimaituah in akihoupih ding ua, amit ngei in amel amu ding;
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;

paite: Zedekiah bel Babulon gam ah api ding a, amah ka veh mateng huai ah a-om nilouh ding; Kaldaite dou mah le uchin na lohching kei ding uh?" " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says Yahweh, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”

paite: Huan Jeremiah in, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Jeremiah said, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Ngai in, na paneu Shallum tapa Hanamel in Anathoth a ka lou nang a ding in lei in, "Gouluah thei na hih ziak in na hon leisak ding ahi chi in na kiang ah ahong pai ding," chi in.
english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

paite: Huchi in ka paneu tapa Hanamel in, "Anathoth a ka lou hon leisak tanla, gouluah thei na hih ziak in na tat ding ahi, nang a ding in lei mai in," achi a. Huchi in hiai TOUPA thu ahi chih ka theita hi.
english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “Then I knew that this was Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel Anathoth a lou ka leita a, dangka ka buksak a, adangkasik shekel sawmsagih tak ahi.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

paite: Huchi in lai ka gelh a, ka hilh a, theihpihmi ka sam a, dangka pen bukna ah ka khai a.
english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

paite: Kileina lai akileidan leh a-omdan gelhna bilh leh bilhlouhte ka la a.
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel mitmuh in leh theihpihmi kileina amin tuang teite mitmuh in leh ngakmi huangsung a Juda tute tengteng ma ah Mahseiah tapa Neriah tapa Baruk ka pia hi.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

paite: Baruk bel ama uah thu ka pia a, Israel' Pathian sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: “I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

paite: "Hiai lai, kileina lai, bilhlouhte la inla, a-om sawttheihna ding in leibel ah koih in.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a; hiai gam ah innte, loute, grephuante mite'n ahon lei nawn ding uh," chi in.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.’

paite: Huan Neriah tapa Baruk kiang ah aleina lai ka piak nung in TOUPA kiang ah ka thum hi.
heading: Jeremiah Thumna
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngai in, na thilhihtheihna thupi leh na khut zak in lei leh van na bawl a; nang a ding in thilhih haksa lua a-om het kei hi.
english: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

paite: Sang tampite kiang ah hehpihna na musak sek a, pate thulimlouhna anung ua atate uh tung ah na thuk a; aw Pathian thupi leh thilhihthei; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi;
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:

paite: thilgel siamtak, thilhihtheitak, mihing tate omdan tengteng muchianpa;
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

paite: michih a-omdan uleh athilhih uh bang a thukpa; Aigupta gam a chiamtehnate leh thillamdang hihpa, tuni tan a Israel leh midang lak a hih zelpa, tuni bang mahmah a min kibawlpa.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

paite: Na mi Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hat leh ban zak leh thil mulkimhuai thupitak in na pikhia hi.
english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

paite: Hiai khuaizu leh nawitui a luang gam apipute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam na peta a;
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: ahong lut ua, aluah vek ua, himahleh na paukam taksang lou in, na dan azui kei uh; hih ding a na piakte ahih kei ua, huaiziak in hiai thil hoih lou tengteng atung uah na tungsak hi.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

paite: En dih, khopi lakna ding a panmun leivupte ahong omta ve; namsaute, kialte, hipite ziak in khopi leng asimmi Kaldaite khut ah piak ahita; na gensa ahong tungta; en dih, na muta hi.
english: “Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.

paite: Ahi a lah, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, nang ka kiang ah, "Na sum in lou lei inla, thu thei mite sam in; khopi bel Kaldaite khut a piak ahita, na chi," achi hi.
english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, kei TOUPA sa nei tengteng Pathian ka hi, kei a ding in haksa lua a-om a hia? chi in.
english: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in hiai khopi Kaldaite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka pe ding a, ala ding hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi simmi Kaldaite ahong pai ding ua, hiai khopi ahal ding ua, akang ding, hon hehsak ding a Baal kiang a gimlim latna, pathian dangte kiang a dawn ding lat butkhiakna inn tung nei inn tengteng toh.
english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

paite: Israel suante leh Judah tate'n atuailai chik ua kipan in ka mitmuh in thil hoih lou ngen ahih uh; Israel suante'n akhut nasepte un ahon hehsak phet uhi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

paite: Hiai a khopi alam tung ua kipan tutan in hon hehsaktu leh hon thangpaisaktu ahi nilouh ngal a; ka ma a kipan ka hihman vengveng theihna ding in; Israel suante leh Judah tate hon hehsak ding a athil hoih lou hihsate tengteng uh ziak in,
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

paite: amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh, Judah mite Jerusalem luah mite tengteng toh.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Kei lam hong nga lou in adeksah uh ahon ngat ua, tawlnga lou hial in sinsakta mah leng, sinsakna lasawn ding in angeingaih kei uhi.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

paite: Ka min tuanna inn hihthanghuai ding in akihhuainate uh akoih zaw uhi.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

paite: Ben Hinnom Phaizang a Baal biakna mun sangte alamkhia ua, atanute uh, atapate uh Molek kiang a mei a apaihna ding un, Judahte thil gilou hihsak ding a hiai kihhuai ahih uh ka thupiak ahi het kei hi, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei kei hi.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in zaw TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, 'Hiai khopi, namsau, kial leh hipi in Babulon kumpipa khut ah piak ahita, na chih nak uh thu ah hichi in achi':
heading: Lametna Thuchiam
english: Now therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”

paite: Ngai dih, ka hehna, ka lung hihlouhna, ka thangpaihna thupi mahmahte a amau ka delh manna gam teng a kipan ka pikhawm ding a, hiai mun ka hon tun ding a, bittak in ka omsakta ding.
english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.

paite: Huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei amaute Pathian ka hi ding.
english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Tangtawn a ahon lauhdet theihna ding un lungtang kibang leh omdan kibang ka bawlsak ding; amau leh anung ua atate uh hoihna ding in.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

paite: Akiang uah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau lehngatsan lou in, ahon launa ka hih gige ding; ahon kiheisanlouhna ding un alungtangte uah ahon lauhna uh ka koih ding.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

paite: Ahi, ahoihna uh hih ka kipah lam ahi ding a, ka lungtang tengteng in hiai gam ah ka phut ngeingei ding.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mite tung a thil hoih lou thupi mahmah ka tut bangtak in amaute kiang a thil hoih ka chiam tengtengte ka tungsak ngeingei ding.
english: For Yahweh says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

paite: Gam kisegawp, Kaldaite khut a piaksa, mi leh sa om nawn lou, na chih gam uah loute akilei nawn ding uhi.
english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’

paite: Benjamin gamte ah, Jerusalem khopi kim munte ah, Judah gam khopite leh simlam khopite ah mite'n dangka in lou alei ding ua, leina lai agelh ding ua, abilh ding ua, theihpih mite asam ding uhi; a-omdan uh ka hei ding hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi."
english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says Yahweh.
